items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: I remember it was Thad Jones “Don’t Get Sassy.” It had to be 15 pages. Chord symbols. It was a professional level chart.

ctx.x: Okay. And then you went to the guitar.

Yes, I mean, again, every kid has this struggle of do I play baseball, do I play a musical instrument and get beaten up for playing tuba or accordion or whatever instrument. Even piano wasn’t as cool as guitar. For some reason I thought I have to be a guitar player. Which, it helped. I sort of learned how to have some dexterity in my left hand. I paid attention to it more than I would have otherwise I suppose. But heavy metal guitar, that was where I was, and thank God Mark Kleckley, what a great name and what a…
